1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.TraceLint
3	  The admission check of a trace written by hand (a reviewer's counterexample), before any rule is
4	  run on it. It reads the trace and, for the witness check, a grounding, a case's entities and one
5	  timestamp: no law, rule, formula, contract or reading parameter. Every check is exact, in
6	  rational arithmetic, with no tolerance: a written trace has no measurement noise, and its author
7	  is shown these rules. Traces a source records are never held to it.
8	
9	  `checkTrace` requires:
10	  - identity: track, region and device ids unique within a scene; at most one measured relation
11	    per ordered pair of tracks within a scene; every reference a scene makes (`Scene.references`)
12	    names an entity of that kind present in the same scene, a sight-along-way entry names a
13	    highway, and an `entrance_of` entry names a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or
14	    path, or a kind refining one (`StructureKind.entranceCarriers`); every track a link names
15	    appears in some scene;
16	  - a static map: the same structures in every scene, each identical at every appearance; every
17	    device that does not move (`Device.mobile`) in every scene; a device identical at every
18	    appearance outside its state (`Device.staticPart`);
19	  - one representation of direction and control: a designated direction (`lane.direction`) is
20	    carried only by a structure a vehicle travels in (`directionKinds`: a lane, reserved lane,
21	    turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder; a centre turn lane
22	    carries none), and is not the zero vector; each carrier stands on its own, and carriers that
23	    overlap or cross may carry different directions. A device whose control is observed governs
24	    only the travel regions whose traffic it controls, or an intersection, read as control of the
25	    junction itself (`governedKinds`); never a highway, a controlled-access region or a region no
26	    vehicle travels in. Only a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or path, or a kind
27	    refining one, carries the intersection it is an approach to (`lane.enters_intersection`); a
28	    roadway, one-way roadway, shoulder or bicycle lane or path that carries one is a directed
29	    approach segment entering that one intersection, which the check cannot see, and a whole
30	    two-way roadway or bicycle path carries none. Only a stop line or a crosswalk
31	    lists the carriers whose entrance it marks (`entrance_of`). A place no carrier covers has no
32	    designated direction, a device whose `governs` is not written has no observed control, and a
33	    line whose `entrance_of` is not written has no observed entrances; none is filled in;
34	  - valid geometry: a boundary has at least three vertices, all distinct (the first is not
35	    repeated at the end), a non-zero area and no self-intersection; an extent's half-length and
36	    half-width are positive; a path length is not negative; a heading is not the zero vector; a
37	    supplied relation's `surface_gap` has no negative component (each is a distance between the
38	    bodies' nearest points, zero on contact or overlap);
39	  - geometric occupancy: a track whose occupancy is observed has a position, a heading and an
40	    extent, and in a scene with such a track every structure has a valid boundary, because a
41	    pair absent from `occupies` is read as not occupied. The pairs of such a track are not
42	    written by hand: `completeOccupancy` derives them, the pair (track, structure) exactly when
43	    the track's footprint (`footprint`) and the structure's boundary overlap as closed sets
44	    (`Geom.polygonsOverlap`), so touching counts and a body on the line between two lanes
45	    occupies both;
46	  - path length: between consecutive observations of a track's path length it never decreases,
47	    and its increase is at least the straight-line distance between the two positions;
48	  - heading against yaw rate: where a track's heading is the same direction at two consecutive
49	    scenes (parallel and not opposed, whatever the vectors' lengths), the yaw rate integrated
50	    between them, ω (t₁ − t₀) with the later sample's rate held over the interval before it, is a
51	    whole number of turns (a multiple of 360°).
52	  `checkReferences` is the identity part alone. A witness trace is held to the whole check, after
53	  `completeOccupancy`, as a reviewer's trace is.
54	  `checkWitness` requires that `at` is the timestamp of a scene, and that every grounded track and
55	  every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene.
56	
57	  Each message names the scene by its timestamp, the entity and the field.
58	-/
59	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
60	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
61	
62	namespace TrafficSpec
63	namespace TraceLint
64	
65	private def dups {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
66	  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups
67	private def at_ (s : Scene) : String := s!"scene t={s.t}"
68	private def qs (q : Q) : String := if q.den == 1 then s!"{q.num}" else s!"{q.num}/{q.den}"
69	private def kindName : EntityKind → String
70	  | .track => "track" | .region => "region" | .device => "device"
71	private def reprStr {α : Type} [Repr α] (x : α) : String := toString (repr x)
72	private def orList (ks : List StructureKind) : String :=
73	  match ks.reverse with
74	  | [] => ""
75	  | [k] => k.toString
76	  | k :: rest => s!"{", ".intercalate (rest.reverse.map (·.toString))} or {k}"
77	
78	/-- Whether an entity of this kind and id is present in the scene. -/
79	def present (s : Scene) (k : EntityKind) (id : Nat) : Bool :=
80	  match k with
81	  | .track => s.tracks.contains id
82	  | .region => (s.structure? id).isSome
83	  | .device => (s.device id).isSome
84	
85	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
86	-- Identity and references
87	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
88	private def identity (s : Scene) : List String :=
89	  (dups s.tracks).map (fun t => s!"{at_ s}: track {t} appears more than once in users")
90	  ++ (dups (s.structures.map (·.id))).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure id {r} appears more than once")
91	  ++ (dups (s.devices.map (·.id))).map (fun d => s!"{at_ s}: device id {d} appears more than once")
92	  ++ (dups (s.relations.map fun m => (m.a, m.b))).map (fun (a, b) => s!"{at_ s}: more than one relation for the ordered pair ({a}, {b})")
93	  ++ s.references.filterMap fun r =>
94	    if !present s r.kind r.id then
95	      some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names {kindName r.kind} {r.id}, which is not in this scene"
96	    else if r.structureKinds.isEmpty then none
97	    else if (s.structure? r.id).map (fun st => r.structureKinds.any (st.kind.refines ·)) == some true then none
98	    else some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names region {r.id}, which is not a {orList r.structureKinds}"
99	
100	private def links (τ : Trace) : List String :=
101	  let all := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
102	  τ.flatMap fun s => s.links.flatMap fun (a, b) =>
103	    ([a, b].filter (!all.contains ·)).map fun t => s!"{at_ s}: links names track {t}, which appears in no scene"
104	
105	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
106	-- The static map and the devices
107	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
108	private def staticMap (τ : Trace) : List String :=
109	  match τ with
110	  | [] => []
111	  | s0 :: _ =>
112	    let ids0 := s0.structures.map (·.id)
113	    let first := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? (·.structure? r)
114	    τ.flatMap fun s =>
115	      let ids := s.structures.map (·.id)
116	      (ids0.filter (!ids.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is missing; the map is the same in every scene")
117	      ++ (ids.filter (!ids0.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is not in the first scene; the map is the same in every scene")
118	      ++ s.structures.filterMap fun st => match first st.id with
119	        | some st0 => if reprStr st0 != reprStr st then some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} differs from its first appearance; every field of a structure is the same in every scene" else none
120	        | none => none
121	
122	private def devices (τ : Trace) : List String :=
123	  let ids := (τ.flatMap fun s => s.devices.map (·.id)).eraseDups
124	  let first := fun (d : DeviceId) => τ.findSome? (·.device d)
125	  τ.flatMap fun s =>
126	    (ids.filterMap fun d => match first d with
127	      | some dv => if !dv.mobile && (s.device d).isNone then some s!"{at_ s}: device {d} is missing; a device that does not move is in every scene" else none
128	      | none => none)
129	    ++ s.devices.filterMap fun dv => match first dv.id with
130	      | some d0 =>
131	        if reprStr d0.staticPart != reprStr dv.staticPart then
132	          some s!"{at_ s}: device {dv.id} differs from its first appearance in a field that is not its state (its state is {String.intercalate ", " Device.stateFields}{if d0.mobile then ", position" else ""})"
133	        else none
134	      | none => none
135	
136	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
137	-- Representation: where a designated direction and a device's control are written
138	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
139	/-- The structure kinds a vehicle travels in that may carry a designated direction. A centre turn
140	    lane, shared by both directions, carries none. -/
141	def directionKinds : List StructureKind :=
142	  [.lane, .reservedLane, .turnLane, .bicycleLaneOrPath, .roadway, .oneWayRoadway, .shoulder]
143	
144	/-- The structure kinds a device may govern: the kinds refining the travel region, the regions
145	    whose traffic it controls and an intersection, read as control of the junction itself and of
146	    nothing else. -/
147	def governedKinds : List StructureKind :=
148	  StructureKind.all.filter fun k => !k.isAbstract && k.refines .travelRegion
149	
150	/-- The structure kinds that mark a carrier's entrance into an intersection. -/
151	def entranceKinds : List StructureKind := [.stopLine, .crosswalk]
152	
153	/-- The structure kinds that carry an entrance into an intersection: those of
154	    `StructureKind.entranceCarriers` and every kind refining one of them. -/
155	def carrierKinds : List StructureKind :=
156	  StructureKind.all.filter fun k => StructureKind.entranceCarriers.any (k.refines ·)
157	
158	/-- The kinds a region may have at each region argument of an atom or primitive, keyed by its Lean
159	    name and the argument's index in its full argument list: `some ks` where the field the name reads
160	    there is carried by, or may name, only a region whose kind is in `ks` (the lists this check and
161	    `Scene.references` hold the field to); `none` where a region of any kind may stand there. A class
162	    atom `st_<kind>` reads the label every region has and is `none`. -/
163	def regionArgKinds : List ((String × Nat) × Option (List StructureKind)) :=
164	  let refining := fun (ks : List StructureKind) => StructureKind.all.filter fun k => ks.any (k.refines ·)
165	  [(("st_lane_enters", 0), some carrierKinds),
166	   (("st_entrance_of", 0), some entranceKinds),
167	   (("st_entrance_of", 1), some (refining StructureKind.entranceCarriers)),
168	   (("st_lane_direction", 0), some directionKinds),
169	   (("dev_governs", 1), some governedKinds),
170	   (("st_sight_along_way", 1), some (refining StructureKind.sightWays)),
171	   (("prim_region_offset_along", 2), some directionKinds)]
172	  ++ ([("st_lane_enters", 1), ("rel_occupies", 1), ("st_road_edge_paved", 0), ("st_shoulder_paved", 0),
173	       ("st_median_or_divider_opening", 0), ("st_crosswalk_marked", 0), ("st_reserved_lane_class", 0),
174	       ("st_turn_lane_side", 0), ("st_parking_space_designation", 0), ("st_curb_zone_kind", 0),
175	       ("st_curb_zone_colour", 0), ("st_obstruction_kind", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency", 2),
176	       ("st_lane_adjacency_left", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency_left", 1), ("st_lane_adjacency_right", 0),
177	       ("st_lane_adjacency_right", 1), ("st_lane_connectivity", 0), ("st_lane_connectivity", 1), ("st_on_way", 0),
178	       ("st_on_way", 1), ("st_lane_marking", 0), ("st_lane_marking_left", 0), ("st_lane_marking_right", 0),
179	       ("st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency_count", 0), ("st_lane_width", 0), ("st_curvature", 0),
180	       ("st_grade", 0), ("st_sight_distance", 0), ("st_parking_space_angle", 0), ("st_region_geometry", 0),
181	       ("st_region_geometry_distance", 1), ("prim_region_lateral_offset", 1), ("prim_region_offset_along", 1)]
182	      ++ StructureKind.all.map fun k => (s!"st_{k}", 0)).map (·, none)
183	
184	private def representation (τ : Trace) : List String :=
185	  let firstStructure := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.structure? r).map fun _ => s.t
186	  let firstDevice := fun (d : DeviceId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.device d).map fun _ => s.t
187	  τ.flatMap fun s =>
188	    (s.structures.flatMap fun st =>
189	      -- the map is static, so each structure is reported once, at its first appearance
190	      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t then []
191	      else match st.lane.bind (·.direction) with
192	        | none => []
193	        | some v =>
194	          (if directionKinds.contains st.kind then []
195	           else [s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries lane.direction; only a lane, reserved lane, turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder does"])
196	          ++ (if Q.isZero v.1 && Q.isZero v.2 then [s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} lane.direction is the zero vector"] else []))
197	    ++ (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
198	      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t || (st.lane.bind (·.entersIntersection)).isNone || carrierKinds.contains st.kind then none
199	      else some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries lane.enters_intersection; only a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or path, or a kind refining one, enters an intersection as an approach")
200	    ++ (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
201	      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t || !st.entranceObserved || entranceKinds.contains st.kind then none
202	      else some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries entrance_of; only a stop line or a crosswalk marks an entrance")
203	    ++ s.devices.flatMap fun dv =>
204	      if firstDevice dv.id != some s.t || !dv.governsObserved then []
205	      else dv.governs.filterMap fun r => match s.structure? r with
206	        | some st =>
207	          if governedKinds.contains st.kind then none
208	          else some s!"{at_ s}: device {dv.id} governs structure {r} ({st.kind.toString}); a device governs the travel regions whose traffic it controls (a lane, reserved lane, turn lane, centre turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder) or an intersection"
209	        | none => none
210	
211	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
212	-- Geometry
213	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
214	/-- What is wrong with a boundary, or nothing. -/
215	def boundaryErrors (poly : List Vec) : List String :=
216	  if poly.length < 3 then ["has fewer than three vertices"]
217	  else if !(dups poly).isEmpty then ["repeats a vertex (the first vertex is not repeated at the end)"]
218	  else if Q.isZero (Geom.area2 poly) then ["has zero area"]
219	  else if Geom.selfIntersects poly then ["intersects itself"]
220	  else []
221	
222	private def geometry (τ : Trace) : List String :=
223	  let firstOf := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.structure? r).map fun _ => s
224	  τ.flatMap fun s =>
225	    (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
226	      -- a structure is static, so its boundary is reported once, at its first appearance
227	      if (firstOf st.id).map (·.t) != some s.t then none
228	      else match st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id with
229	        | some poly => match boundaryErrors poly with
230	          | [] => none
231	          | e :: _ => some s!"{at_ s}: the boundary of structure {st.id} {e}"
232	        | none => none)
233	    ++ (s.relations.filterMap fun m => match m.surfaceGap with
234	      | some (lon, lat) =>
235	        if Q.lt lon Q.zero || Q.lt lat Q.zero then
236	          some s!"{at_ s}: relation ({m.a}, {m.b}) surface_gap ({qs lon}, {qs lat}) has a negative component; each component is a distance between the bodies' nearest points, along and across a's heading, zero on contact or overlap"
237	        else none
238	      | none => none)
239	    ++ s.tracks.flatMap fun x =>
240	      (match kin_extent s x with
241	       | some (l, w, _) => if Q.le l Q.zero || Q.le w Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} extent: the half-length and the half-width must be positive"] else []
242	       | none => [])
243	      ++ (match kin_path_length s x with
244	       | some p => if Q.lt p Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} path_length {qs p} is negative"] else []
245	       | none => [])
246	      ++ (match kin_heading s x with
247	       | some h => if Q.isZero h.1 && Q.isZero h.2 then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} heading is the zero vector"] else []
248	       | none => [])
249	
250	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
251	-- Occupancy, path length, heading against yaw rate
252	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
253	/-- The trace with the occupancy of every observed track derived from the geometry: in each scene,
254	    for a track in `occupancy_observed` whose footprint is defined, `occupies` holds the pair
255	    (track, structure) exactly when the footprint and the structure's valid boundary overlap as
256	    closed sets; what the trace listed for that track is replaced, every other pair kept. -/
257	def completeOccupancy (τ : Trace) : Trace :=
258	  τ.map fun s =>
259	    let derived := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups.filter (footprint s · |>.isSome)
260	    let kept := s.occupies.filter fun (t, _) => !derived.contains t
261	    let made := derived.flatMap fun t => match footprint s t with
262	      | none => []
263	      | some fp => s.structures.filterMap fun st => match st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id with
264	        | some poly => if (boundaryErrors poly).isEmpty && Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some (t, st.id) else none
265	        | none => none
266	    { s with occupies := kept ++ made }
267	
268	private def occupancy (s : Scene) : List String :=
269	  let obs := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups
270	  if obs.isEmpty then []
271	  else
272	    let bodies := obs.filterMap fun t =>
273	      if (footprint s t).isNone then
274	        some s!"{at_ s}: track {t} is in occupancy_observed but lacks a position, a non-zero heading or an extent, so its footprint is undefined"
275	      else none
276	    let unbounded := s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
277	      if (st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id).isNone then
278	        some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} has no boundary; where occupancy is observed every structure needs one, since a pair left out of occupies is read as not occupied"
279	      else none
280	    bodies ++ unbounded
281	
282	private def pathLength (τ : Trace) : List String :=
283	  let tracks := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
284	  tracks.flatMap fun x =>
285	    let obs := τ.filterMap fun s => (kin_path_length s x).map fun p => (s, p, kin_position s x)
286	    (obs.zip (obs.drop 1)).flatMap fun ((s0, p0, q0), (s1, p1, q1)) =>
287	      let inc := Q.sub p1 p0
288	      if Q.lt inc Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length {qs p1} is less than {qs p0} at t={s0.t}; it never decreases"]
289	      else match q0, q1 with
290	        | some a, some b =>
291	          if Q.lt (Q.mul inc inc) (Geom.normSq (Geom.vsub b a)) then
292	            [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length grows by {qs inc} m since t={s0.t}, less than the straight-line distance between its two positions"]
293	          else []
294	        | _, _ => []
295	
296	/-- Whether two non-zero headings are the same direction: parallel and not opposed. -/
297	def sameDirection (a b : Vec) : Bool := Q.isZero (Geom.cross a b) && Q.gt (Geom.dot a b) Q.zero
298	
299	/-- Whether an angle in degrees is a whole number of turns. -/
300	def wholeTurns (deg : Q) : Bool := deg.num % (360 * (deg.den : Int)) == 0
301	
302	private def yaw (τ : Trace) : List String :=
303	  (τ.zip (τ.drop 1)).flatMap fun (s0, s1) =>
304	    s1.tracks.filterMap fun x =>
305	      match kin_heading s0 x, kin_heading s1 x, kin_yaw_rate s1 x with
306	      | some h0, some h1, some ω =>
307	        if !sameDirection h0 h1 then none
308	        else
309	          let turn := Q.mul ω (Q.sub (Time.ofTimestamp s1.t) (Time.ofTimestamp s0.t))
310	          if wholeTurns turn then none
311	          else some s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} keeps the heading it had at t={s0.t}, but its yaw rate turns it {qs turn}° over the interval (the rate at a scene is held over the interval before it)"
312	      | _, _, _ => none
313	
314	/-- The identity and reference defects of a trace: what no adapter output can contain, whoever
315	    wrote it. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
316	def checkReferences (τ : Trace) : List String :=
317	  τ.flatMap identity ++ links τ
318	
319	/-- Every inconsistency of a written trace. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
320	def checkTrace (τ : Trace) : List String :=
321	  checkReferences τ ++ staticMap τ ++ devices τ ++ representation τ ++ geometry τ
322	    ++ τ.flatMap occupancy ++ pathLength τ ++ yaw τ
323	
324	/-- Every defect of the witness instant: `at` is a scene's timestamp, and every grounded track and
325	    every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene. -/
326	def checkWitness (τ : Trace) (grounding : List (String × TrackId)) (entities : List (String × Val)) (at_ms : Timestamp) : List String :=
327	  match τ.find? (·.t == at_ms) with
328	  | none => [s!"at {at_ms} is not the timestamp of any scene"]
329	  | some s =>
330	    (grounding.filterMap fun (b, t) =>
331	      if s.tracks.contains t then none else some s!"scene t={at_ms}: binder {b} is grounded to track {t}, which is not in this scene")
332	    ++ entities.filterMap fun (n, v) =>
333	      if present s v.kind (match v with | .track t => t | .region r => r | .device d => d) then none
334	      else some s!"scene t={at_ms}: entity {n} is {kindName v.kind} {match v with | .track t => t | .region r => r | .device d => d}, which is not in this scene"
335	
336	end TraceLint
337	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.TraceLint
  The admission check of a trace written by hand (a reviewer's counterexample), before any rule is
  run on it. It reads the trace and, for the witness check, a grounding, a case's entities and one
  timestamp: no law, rule, formula, contract or reading parameter. Every check is exact, in
  rational arithmetic, with no tolerance: a written trace has no measurement noise, and its author
  is shown these rules. Traces a source records are never held to it.

  `checkTrace` requires:
  - identity: track, region and device ids unique within a scene; at most one measured relation
    per ordered pair of tracks within a scene; every reference a scene makes (`Scene.references`)
    names an entity of that kind present in the same scene, a sight-along-way entry names a
    highway, and an `entrance_of` entry names a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or
    path, or a kind refining one (`StructureKind.entranceCarriers`); every track a link names
    appears in some scene;
  - a static map: the same structures in every scene, each identical at every appearance; every
    device that does not move (`Device.mobile`) in every scene; a device identical at every
    appearance outside its state (`Device.staticPart`);
  - one representation of direction and control: a designated direction (`lane.direction`) is
    carried only by a structure a vehicle travels in (`directionKinds`: a lane, reserved lane,
    turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder; a centre turn lane
    carries none), and is not the zero vector; each carrier stands on its own, and carriers that
    overlap or cross may carry different directions. A device whose control is observed governs
    only the travel regions whose traffic it controls, or an intersection, read as control of the
    junction itself (`governedKinds`); never a highway, a controlled-access region or a region no
    vehicle travels in. Only a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or path, or a kind
    refining one, carries the intersection it is an approach to (`lane.enters_intersection`); a
    roadway, one-way roadway, shoulder or bicycle lane or path that carries one is a directed
    approach segment entering that one intersection, which the check cannot see, and a whole
    two-way roadway or bicycle path carries none. Only a stop line or a crosswalk
    lists the carriers whose entrance it marks (`entrance_of`). A place no carrier covers has no
    designated direction, a device whose `governs` is not written has no observed control, and a
    line whose `entrance_of` is not written has no observed entrances; none is filled in;
  - valid geometry: a boundary has at least three vertices, all distinct (the first is not
    repeated at the end), a non-zero area and no self-intersection; an extent's half-length and
    half-width are positive; a path length is not negative; a heading is not the zero vector; a
    supplied relation's `surface_gap` has no negative component (each is a distance between the
    bodies' nearest points, zero on contact or overlap);
  - geometric occupancy: a track whose occupancy is observed has a position, a heading and an
    extent, and in a scene with such a track every structure has a valid boundary, because a
    pair absent from `occupies` is read as not occupied. The pairs of such a track are not
    written by hand: `completeOccupancy` derives them, the pair (track, structure) exactly when
    the track's footprint (`footprint`) and the structure's boundary overlap as closed sets
    (`Geom.polygonsOverlap`), so touching counts and a body on the line between two lanes
    occupies both;
  - path length: between consecutive observations of a track's path length it never decreases,
    and its increase is at least the straight-line distance between the two positions;
  - heading against yaw rate: where a track's heading is the same direction at two consecutive
    scenes (parallel and not opposed, whatever the vectors' lengths), the yaw rate integrated
    between them, ω (t₁ − t₀) with the later sample's rate held over the interval before it, is a
    whole number of turns (a multiple of 360°).
  `checkReferences` is the identity part alone. A witness trace is held to the whole check, after
  `completeOccupancy`, as a reviewer's trace is.
  `checkWitness` requires that `at` is the timestamp of a scene, and that every grounded track and
  every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene.

  Each message names the scene by its timestamp, the entity and the field.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Atoms
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace TraceLint

private def dups {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups
private def at_ (s : Scene) : String := s!"scene t={s.t}"
private def qs (q : Q) : String := if q.den == 1 then s!"{q.num}" else s!"{q.num}/{q.den}"
private def kindName : EntityKind → String
  | .track => "track" | .region => "region" | .device => "device"
private def reprStr {α : Type} [Repr α] (x : α) : String := toString (repr x)
private def orList (ks : List StructureKind) : String :=
  match ks.reverse with
  | [] => ""
  | [k] => k.toString
  | k :: rest => s!"{", ".intercalate (rest.reverse.map (·.toString))} or {k}"

/-- Whether an entity of this kind and id is present in the scene. -/
def present (s : Scene) (k : EntityKind) (id : Nat) : Bool :=
  match k with
  | .track => s.tracks.contains id
  | .region => (s.structure? id).isSome
  | .device => (s.device id).isSome

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Identity and references
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def identity (s : Scene) : List String :=
  (dups s.tracks).map (fun t => s!"{at_ s}: track {t} appears more than once in users")
  ++ (dups (s.structures.map (·.id))).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure id {r} appears more than once")
  ++ (dups (s.devices.map (·.id))).map (fun d => s!"{at_ s}: device id {d} appears more than once")
  ++ (dups (s.relations.map fun m => (m.a, m.b))).map (fun (a, b) => s!"{at_ s}: more than one relation for the ordered pair ({a}, {b})")
  ++ s.references.filterMap fun r =>
    if !present s r.kind r.id then
      some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names {kindName r.kind} {r.id}, which is not in this scene"
    else if r.structureKinds.isEmpty then none
    else if (s.structure? r.id).map (fun st => r.structureKinds.any (st.kind.refines ·)) == some true then none
    else some s!"{at_ s}: {r.place} names region {r.id}, which is not a {orList r.structureKinds}"

private def links (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let all := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
  τ.flatMap fun s => s.links.flatMap fun (a, b) =>
    ([a, b].filter (!all.contains ·)).map fun t => s!"{at_ s}: links names track {t}, which appears in no scene"

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The static map and the devices
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def staticMap (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  match τ with
  | [] => []
  | s0 :: _ =>
    let ids0 := s0.structures.map (·.id)
    let first := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? (·.structure? r)
    τ.flatMap fun s =>
      let ids := s.structures.map (·.id)
      (ids0.filter (!ids.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is missing; the map is the same in every scene")
      ++ (ids.filter (!ids0.contains ·)).map (fun r => s!"{at_ s}: structure {r} is not in the first scene; the map is the same in every scene")
      ++ s.structures.filterMap fun st => match first st.id with
        | some st0 => if reprStr st0 != reprStr st then some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} differs from its first appearance; every field of a structure is the same in every scene" else none
        | none => none

private def devices (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let ids := (τ.flatMap fun s => s.devices.map (·.id)).eraseDups
  let first := fun (d : DeviceId) => τ.findSome? (·.device d)
  τ.flatMap fun s =>
    (ids.filterMap fun d => match first d with
      | some dv => if !dv.mobile && (s.device d).isNone then some s!"{at_ s}: device {d} is missing; a device that does not move is in every scene" else none
      | none => none)
    ++ s.devices.filterMap fun dv => match first dv.id with
      | some d0 =>
        if reprStr d0.staticPart != reprStr dv.staticPart then
          some s!"{at_ s}: device {dv.id} differs from its first appearance in a field that is not its state (its state is {String.intercalate ", " Device.stateFields}{if d0.mobile then ", position" else ""})"
        else none
      | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Representation: where a designated direction and a device's control are written
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The structure kinds a vehicle travels in that may carry a designated direction. A centre turn
    lane, shared by both directions, carries none. -/
def directionKinds : List StructureKind :=
  [.lane, .reservedLane, .turnLane, .bicycleLaneOrPath, .roadway, .oneWayRoadway, .shoulder]

/-- The structure kinds a device may govern: the kinds refining the travel region, the regions
    whose traffic it controls and an intersection, read as control of the junction itself and of
    nothing else. -/
def governedKinds : List StructureKind :=
  StructureKind.all.filter fun k => !k.isAbstract && k.refines .travelRegion

/-- The structure kinds that mark a carrier's entrance into an intersection. -/
def entranceKinds : List StructureKind := [.stopLine, .crosswalk]

/-- The structure kinds that carry an entrance into an intersection: those of
    `StructureKind.entranceCarriers` and every kind refining one of them. -/
def carrierKinds : List StructureKind :=
  StructureKind.all.filter fun k => StructureKind.entranceCarriers.any (k.refines ·)

/-- The kinds a region may have at each region argument of an atom or primitive, keyed by its Lean
    name and the argument's index in its full argument list: `some ks` where the field the name reads
    there is carried by, or may name, only a region whose kind is in `ks` (the lists this check and
    `Scene.references` hold the field to); `none` where a region of any kind may stand there. A class
    atom `st_<kind>` reads the label every region has and is `none`. -/
def regionArgKinds : List ((String × Nat) × Option (List StructureKind)) :=
  let refining := fun (ks : List StructureKind) => StructureKind.all.filter fun k => ks.any (k.refines ·)
  [(("st_lane_enters", 0), some carrierKinds),
   (("st_entrance_of", 0), some entranceKinds),
   (("st_entrance_of", 1), some (refining StructureKind.entranceCarriers)),
   (("st_lane_direction", 0), some directionKinds),
   (("dev_governs", 1), some governedKinds),
   (("st_sight_along_way", 1), some (refining StructureKind.sightWays)),
   (("prim_region_offset_along", 2), some directionKinds)]
  ++ ([("st_lane_enters", 1), ("rel_occupies", 1), ("st_road_edge_paved", 0), ("st_shoulder_paved", 0),
       ("st_median_or_divider_opening", 0), ("st_crosswalk_marked", 0), ("st_reserved_lane_class", 0),
       ("st_turn_lane_side", 0), ("st_parking_space_designation", 0), ("st_curb_zone_kind", 0),
       ("st_curb_zone_colour", 0), ("st_obstruction_kind", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency", 2),
       ("st_lane_adjacency_left", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency_left", 1), ("st_lane_adjacency_right", 0),
       ("st_lane_adjacency_right", 1), ("st_lane_connectivity", 0), ("st_lane_connectivity", 1), ("st_on_way", 0),
       ("st_on_way", 1), ("st_lane_marking", 0), ("st_lane_marking_left", 0), ("st_lane_marking_right", 0),
       ("st_lane_adjacency_ordinal", 0), ("st_lane_adjacency_count", 0), ("st_lane_width", 0), ("st_curvature", 0),
       ("st_grade", 0), ("st_sight_distance", 0), ("st_parking_space_angle", 0), ("st_region_geometry", 0),
       ("st_region_geometry_distance", 1), ("prim_region_lateral_offset", 1), ("prim_region_offset_along", 1)]
      ++ StructureKind.all.map fun k => (s!"st_{k}", 0)).map (·, none)

private def representation (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let firstStructure := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.structure? r).map fun _ => s.t
  let firstDevice := fun (d : DeviceId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.device d).map fun _ => s.t
  τ.flatMap fun s =>
    (s.structures.flatMap fun st =>
      -- the map is static, so each structure is reported once, at its first appearance
      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t then []
      else match st.lane.bind (·.direction) with
        | none => []
        | some v =>
          (if directionKinds.contains st.kind then []
           else [s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries lane.direction; only a lane, reserved lane, turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder does"])
          ++ (if Q.isZero v.1 && Q.isZero v.2 then [s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} lane.direction is the zero vector"] else []))
    ++ (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t || (st.lane.bind (·.entersIntersection)).isNone || carrierKinds.contains st.kind then none
      else some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries lane.enters_intersection; only a lane, a roadway, a shoulder or a bicycle lane or path, or a kind refining one, enters an intersection as an approach")
    ++ (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      if firstStructure st.id != some s.t || !st.entranceObserved || entranceKinds.contains st.kind then none
      else some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} ({st.kind.toString}) carries entrance_of; only a stop line or a crosswalk marks an entrance")
    ++ s.devices.flatMap fun dv =>
      if firstDevice dv.id != some s.t || !dv.governsObserved then []
      else dv.governs.filterMap fun r => match s.structure? r with
        | some st =>
          if governedKinds.contains st.kind then none
          else some s!"{at_ s}: device {dv.id} governs structure {r} ({st.kind.toString}); a device governs the travel regions whose traffic it controls (a lane, reserved lane, turn lane, centre turn lane, bicycle lane or path, roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder) or an intersection"
        | none => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Geometry
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- What is wrong with a boundary, or nothing. -/
def boundaryErrors (poly : List Vec) : List String :=
  if poly.length < 3 then ["has fewer than three vertices"]
  else if !(dups poly).isEmpty then ["repeats a vertex (the first vertex is not repeated at the end)"]
  else if Q.isZero (Geom.area2 poly) then ["has zero area"]
  else if Geom.selfIntersects poly then ["intersects itself"]
  else []

private def geometry (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let firstOf := fun (r : RegionId) => τ.findSome? fun s => (s.structure? r).map fun _ => s
  τ.flatMap fun s =>
    (s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      -- a structure is static, so its boundary is reported once, at its first appearance
      if (firstOf st.id).map (·.t) != some s.t then none
      else match st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id with
        | some poly => match boundaryErrors poly with
          | [] => none
          | e :: _ => some s!"{at_ s}: the boundary of structure {st.id} {e}"
        | none => none)
    ++ (s.relations.filterMap fun m => match m.surfaceGap with
      | some (lon, lat) =>
        if Q.lt lon Q.zero || Q.lt lat Q.zero then
          some s!"{at_ s}: relation ({m.a}, {m.b}) surface_gap ({qs lon}, {qs lat}) has a negative component; each component is a distance between the bodies' nearest points, along and across a's heading, zero on contact or overlap"
        else none
      | none => none)
    ++ s.tracks.flatMap fun x =>
      (match kin_extent s x with
       | some (l, w, _) => if Q.le l Q.zero || Q.le w Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} extent: the half-length and the half-width must be positive"] else []
       | none => [])
      ++ (match kin_path_length s x with
       | some p => if Q.lt p Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} path_length {qs p} is negative"] else []
       | none => [])
      ++ (match kin_heading s x with
       | some h => if Q.isZero h.1 && Q.isZero h.2 then [s!"{at_ s}: track {x} heading is the zero vector"] else []
       | none => [])

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Occupancy, path length, heading against yaw rate
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The trace with the occupancy of every observed track derived from the geometry: in each scene,
    for a track in `occupancy_observed` whose footprint is defined, `occupies` holds the pair
    (track, structure) exactly when the footprint and the structure's valid boundary overlap as
    closed sets; what the trace listed for that track is replaced, every other pair kept. -/
def completeOccupancy (τ : Trace) : Trace :=
  τ.map fun s =>
    let derived := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups.filter (footprint s · |>.isSome)
    let kept := s.occupies.filter fun (t, _) => !derived.contains t
    let made := derived.flatMap fun t => match footprint s t with
      | none => []
      | some fp => s.structures.filterMap fun st => match st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id with
        | some poly => if (boundaryErrors poly).isEmpty && Geom.polygonsOverlap fp poly then some (t, st.id) else none
        | none => none
    { s with occupies := kept ++ made }

private def occupancy (s : Scene) : List String :=
  let obs := (s.occupancyObserved.filter (s.tracks.contains ·)).eraseDups
  if obs.isEmpty then []
  else
    let bodies := obs.filterMap fun t =>
      if (footprint s t).isNone then
        some s!"{at_ s}: track {t} is in occupancy_observed but lacks a position, a non-zero heading or an extent, so its footprint is undefined"
      else none
    let unbounded := s.structures.filterMap fun st =>
      if (st_region_geometry_boundary s st.id).isNone then
        some s!"{at_ s}: structure {st.id} has no boundary; where occupancy is observed every structure needs one, since a pair left out of occupies is read as not occupied"
      else none
    bodies ++ unbounded

private def pathLength (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  let tracks := (τ.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
  tracks.flatMap fun x =>
    let obs := τ.filterMap fun s => (kin_path_length s x).map fun p => (s, p, kin_position s x)
    (obs.zip (obs.drop 1)).flatMap fun ((s0, p0, q0), (s1, p1, q1)) =>
      let inc := Q.sub p1 p0
      if Q.lt inc Q.zero then [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length {qs p1} is less than {qs p0} at t={s0.t}; it never decreases"]
      else match q0, q1 with
        | some a, some b =>
          if Q.lt (Q.mul inc inc) (Geom.normSq (Geom.vsub b a)) then
            [s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} path_length grows by {qs inc} m since t={s0.t}, less than the straight-line distance between its two positions"]
          else []
        | _, _ => []

/-- Whether two non-zero headings are the same direction: parallel and not opposed. -/
def sameDirection (a b : Vec) : Bool := Q.isZero (Geom.cross a b) && Q.gt (Geom.dot a b) Q.zero

/-- Whether an angle in degrees is a whole number of turns. -/
def wholeTurns (deg : Q) : Bool := deg.num % (360 * (deg.den : Int)) == 0

private def yaw (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  (τ.zip (τ.drop 1)).flatMap fun (s0, s1) =>
    s1.tracks.filterMap fun x =>
      match kin_heading s0 x, kin_heading s1 x, kin_yaw_rate s1 x with
      | some h0, some h1, some ω =>
        if !sameDirection h0 h1 then none
        else
          let turn := Q.mul ω (Q.sub (Time.ofTimestamp s1.t) (Time.ofTimestamp s0.t))
          if wholeTurns turn then none
          else some s!"{at_ s1}: track {x} keeps the heading it had at t={s0.t}, but its yaw rate turns it {qs turn}° over the interval (the rate at a scene is held over the interval before it)"
      | _, _, _ => none

/-- The identity and reference defects of a trace: what no adapter output can contain, whoever
    wrote it. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
def checkReferences (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  τ.flatMap identity ++ links τ

/-- Every inconsistency of a written trace. Empty for a trace that passes. -/
def checkTrace (τ : Trace) : List String :=
  checkReferences τ ++ staticMap τ ++ devices τ ++ representation τ ++ geometry τ
    ++ τ.flatMap occupancy ++ pathLength τ ++ yaw τ

/-- Every defect of the witness instant: `at` is a scene's timestamp, and every grounded track and
    every entity of the case, with its declared kind, is present in that scene. -/
def checkWitness (τ : Trace) (grounding : List (String × TrackId)) (entities : List (String × Val)) (at_ms : Timestamp) : List String :=
  match τ.find? (·.t == at_ms) with
  | none => [s!"at {at_ms} is not the timestamp of any scene"]
  | some s =>
    (grounding.filterMap fun (b, t) =>
      if s.tracks.contains t then none else some s!"scene t={at_ms}: binder {b} is grounded to track {t}, which is not in this scene")
    ++ entities.filterMap fun (n, v) =>
      if present s v.kind (match v with | .track t => t | .region r => r | .device d => d) then none
      else some s!"scene t={at_ms}: entity {n} is {kindName v.kind} {match v with | .track t => t | .region r => r | .device d => d}, which is not in this scene"

end TraceLint
end TrafficSpec

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders
3	  Scenarios for witnesses and tests: a scene and a trace from a few named quantities, padding by
4	  timestamp, masking under a manifest, and the `Scenario` a witness file declares.
5	
6	  A witness must be indistinguishable from adapter output to an atom, so everything here goes
7	  through the `World` constructors and nothing else. Reachable from `Witness/**` and `Tests/**`
8	  only: a rule that could build its own evidence proves nothing.
9	
10	  No default magnitude lives here — every extent, speed and distance is an argument the witness
11	  writes through a `Units` constructor.
12	-/
13	import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor
14	
15	namespace TrafficSpec
16	namespace Build
17

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders
  Scenarios for witnesses and tests: a scene and a trace from a few named quantities, padding by
  timestamp, masking under a manifest, and the `Scenario` a witness file declares.

  A witness must be indistinguishable from adapter output to an atom, so everything here goes
  through the `World` constructors and nothing else. Reachable from `Witness/**` and `Tests/**`
  only: a rule that could build its own evidence proves nothing.

  No default magnitude lives here — every extent, speed and distance is an argument the witness
  writes through a `Units` constructor.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Monitor

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Build

/-- Cardinal unit headings in the world frame (+x east, +y north). -/
def east : Vec := (Q.ofInt 1, Q.zero)
def west : Vec := (Q.ofInt (-1), Q.zero)
def north : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt 1)
def south : Vec := (Q.zero, Q.ofInt (-1))

def scale (h : Vec) (k : Q) : Vec := (Q.mul h.1 k, Q.mul h.2 k)

/-- A road user with position, heading and speed; velocity follows the heading, path length
    is the caller's (cumulative) figure, extents are half-length/half-width/half-height. -/
def user (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q)
    (halfExtent : Q × Q × Q) (pathLength : Option Q := none) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track
    classes := some classes
    kin := { position := some pos
             heading := some heading
             velocity := some (scale heading speed)
             speed := some speed
             extent := some halfExtent
             pathLength := pathLength } }

/-- A road user of which only the position (and classes) was observed. -/
def sparseUser (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (pos : Vec) : RoadUser :=
  { track := track, classes := some classes, kin := { position := some pos } }

def withSignals (u : RoadUser) (f : Signals → Signals) : RoadUser := { u with sig := f u.sig }
def withKin (u : RoadUser) (f : Kin → Kin) : RoadUser := { u with kin := f u.kin }
/-- A measured relation from `a` to `b`, with the measured fields the source supplies. -/
def relation (a b : TrackId) (f : MeasuredRelation → MeasuredRelation := id) : MeasuredRelation := f { a := a, b := b }
def withRelations (s : Scene) (rs : List MeasuredRelation) : Scene := { s with relations := rs }

/-- A region of a kind with a polygon boundary. -/
def region (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (boundary : List Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, boundary := some boundary }
/-- An axis-aligned rectangular region from two corners. -/
def rect (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Q) : Structure :=
  region id kind [(x0, y0), (x1, y0), (x1, y1), (x0, y1)]
/-- A lane with its direction and neighbours. -/
def lane (id : RegionId) (boundary : List Vec) (direction : Vec)
    (left right : Option RegionId := none) (ordinal count : Option Nat := none)
    (leadsTo : Option (List RegionId) := none) (enters : Option RegionId := none) : Structure :=
  { id := id
    kind := .lane
    boundary := some boundary
    lane := some { direction := some direction, leftNeighbour := left, rightNeighbour := right,
                   ordinalFromLeft := ordinal, countInDirection := count, leadsTo := leadsTo,
                   entersIntersection := enters } }
def point (id : RegionId) (kind : StructureKind) (pos : Vec) : Structure :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, position := some pos }

def device (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) (pos : Option Vec := none) : Device :=
  { id := id, kind := kind, governs := governs, position := pos }
def signal (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (shows : List SignalIndication) : Device :=
  { device id .trafficSignal governs with indications := some shows }
def sign (id : DeviceId) (kind : DeviceKind) (governs : List RegionId) : Device := device id kind governs
def speedLimit (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (value : Q) (kind : SpeedSignKind) : Device :=
  { device id .speedLimitSign governs with speedValue := some value, speedKind := some kind }
def zoneSign (id : DeviceId) (governs : List RegionId) (kind : ZoneKind) (isEnd : Bool)
    (conditions : Option Conditions := none) : Device :=
  { device id .zoneSign governs with zoneKind := some kind, isEnd := some isEnd, conditions := conditions }

/-- Occupancy from the geometry: every user inside every region whose boundary contains its position. -/
def occupancyFromGeometry (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  users.flatMap fun u =>
    match u.kin.position with
    | none => []
    | some p => structures.filterMap fun st =>
      match st.boundary with
      | some poly => if Geom.inPolygon p poly then some (u.track, st.id) else none
      | none => none

/-- A scene; occupancy is derived from geometry unless given. -/
def scene (t : Timestamp) (subject : Option TrackId) (users : List RoadUser) (structures : List Structure)
    (devices : List Device) (occupies : Option (List (TrackId × RegionId)) := none)
    (env : Env := {}) (assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []) (intents : List DeclaredIntent := []) : Scene :=
  { t := t
    subject := subject
    users := users
    structures := structures
    devices := devices
    occupancyObserved := users.map (·.track)
    occupies := occupies.getD (occupancyFromGeometry users structures)
    env := env
    assumptions := assumptions
    intents := intents }

/-- A trace from a scene generator over instants `t0, t0 + dt, …` (`dt` in seconds). -/
def trace (n : Nat) (t0 : Timestamp) (dt : Q) (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace :=
  (List.range n).map fun k =>
    let t : Timestamp := t0 + (Q.mul (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)) (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000))).num /
      (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    f k t

/-- Repeat the first and last scenes for `before`/`after` seconds at spacing `dt`, so that windows
    at the ends of the interesting part are covered rather than truncated. -/
def pad (τ : Trace) (before after dt : Q) : Trace :=
  match τ.head?, τ.getLast? with
  | some first, some last =>
    let step : Timestamp := (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).num / (Q.mul dt (Q.ofInt 1000)).den
    let nb := ((Q.div before dt).num / (Q.div before dt).den).toNat
    let na := ((Q.div after dt).num / (Q.div after dt).den).toNat
    let pre := (List.range nb).reverse.map fun k => { first with t := first.t - step * (k + 1) }
    let post := (List.range na).map fun k => { last with t := last.t + step * (k + 1) }
    pre ++ τ ++ post
  | _, _ => τ

def masked (m : Manifest) (τ : Trace) : Trace := maskTrace m τ

/-- A manifest that observes every atom except the listed ids (for a `blind` witness). -/
def manifest (absent : List String := []) (gap : Q := Q.zero) : Manifest :=
  let full := Manifest.full "witness" gap
  { full with entries := full.entries.map fun (id, c) => if absent.contains id then (id, .absent) else (id, c) }

end Build

/-- A witness: a rule, a trace, the reading and manifest it assumes, the grounding it speaks
    about (binder ↦ track) and the episode verdict the plan declared over `window` (a closed range
    of timestamps; the whole trace when absent). A lookback window is truncated at the start of
    every finite trace, so a witness about a rule with one names the instants it speaks about.
    A witness is a test of the rule, not evidence about the law: it shows the formulas reach the
    verdict it names, on a scene its author built. A history-boundary witness (`boundary` names the
    history its trace lacks) shows that the rule stays unknown where the trace does not reach back
    far enough to decide it. -/
structure Scenario where
  name : String
  rule : String
  trace : Trace
  reading : Reading
  manifest : Manifest
  grounding : List (String × TrackId)
  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []   -- an instance's region formals, each a region of the trace
  expected : Verdict
  window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := none
  boundary : String := ""
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

namespace Scenario
/-- The operators that look back from the observation they judge, by the tag their truncation at the
    start of a trace carries: only these leave a history-boundary witness unknown. -/
def pastOps : List String :=
  ["since", "since_rise", "rises", "once", "holdsFor", "atLast", "count", "distance_while", "prim_heading_change",
   "heading_since"]

/-- The witness holds when the rule's episode verdict on its grounding has the expected tag, and
    the verdict is reached for the reason the witness is about: a `notApplicable` witness needs an
    instant at which every bound track is present (a track that never appears leaves any rule not
    engaged); an `unknown` witness must be unknown only for atoms its manifest masks (an unbound
    variable, a truncated window or a missing parameter is a defect, not a masked observation),
    except that a history-boundary witness is unknown for a window truncated at the start of its
    trace, at least once, and otherwise only for masked atoms; a boundary is declared on an
    `unknown` witness only.
    The rules are evaluated with their concept calls expanded over `concepts`. A trace the
    admission rejects, or a region formal given a region no scene of the trace holds, fails. -/
def run (rules : List Rule) (sc : Scenario) (concepts : List Concept := []) : Except String Verdict := do
  let rules := rules.map (Concept.expandRule concepts)
  let r ← match rules.find? (·.id == sc.rule) with
    | some r => pure r
    | none => throw s!"{sc.name}: rule {sc.rule} is not registered"
  let S ← match Grounding.Setup.admit rules (maskTrace sc.manifest sc.trace) sc.reading sc.manifest.reidGap with
    | .ok S => pure S
    | .error ds => throw s!"{sc.name}: the trace is not admitted: {"; ".intercalate ds}"
  for (n, reg) in sc.regions do
    if !(sc.trace.any fun s => (s.structure? reg).isSome) then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: region formal `{n}` is region {reg}, which is no structure of the trace"
  let g : Grounding.Grounding := ⟨sc.grounding.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Grounding.canon S.cm t)), sc.regions⟩
  let tl := Grounding.evaluate S r g
  let rows := tl.verdicts.toList.filter fun (t, _) =>
    match sc.window with
    | some (a, b) => a ≤ t && t ≤ b
    | none => true
  let got := Grounding.episode (rows.map (·.2))
  if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && sc.expected.tag != "unknown" then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: a history boundary is declared on a witness that expects {sc.expected.tag}, not unknown"
  if got.tag != sc.expected.tag then
    throw s!"{sc.name}: expected {sc.expected.tag}, got {got.tag} {(got.reasons.map UnknownReason.tag)}"
  match sc.expected with
  | .notApplicable =>
    if tl.present then pure got
    else throw s!"{sc.name}: not applicable, but no instant has every bound track present"
  | .unknown _ =>
    let absent := sc.manifest.absentIds
    let truncated := fun (w : UnknownReason) => match w with | .windowTruncated op => pastOps.contains op | _ => false
    let stray := got.reasons.filter fun w => match w with
      | .absentAtom n => !(atomIdOf n).any absent.contains
      | w => sc.boundary.isEmpty || !truncated w
    if !stray.isEmpty then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: unknown for {(stray.map UnknownReason.tag)}, not for an atom the manifest masks{if sc.boundary.isEmpty then "" else " or a window truncated at the trace start"}"
    else if !sc.boundary.isEmpty && !got.reasons.any truncated then
      throw s!"{sc.name}: a history-boundary witness, but no window is truncated at the trace start"
    else pure got
  | _ => pure got
end Scenario

end TrafficSpec

1	/-
2	  TRAINING SPLIT variant, generated by harness/tools/split.py from the full file: the lines that read the
3	  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.
4	-/
5	/-
6	  TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Manifest
7	  What a source can observe: a capability per atom id, complete over ATOMS.md (`subject` is an atom
8	  observed for the subject track alone, as an instrumented vehicle reports its own controls); a mask
9	  that blanks every field of an absent atom, and of a subject-only atom on every other road user,
10	  before evaluation; and `support`, the first and most honest number
11	  a source gets — which rules it can be judged against at all, computed from the rules' syntax
12	  before any frame is read.
13	
14	  The same rules run on a simulator, on an annotated dataset and on perception over video; the
15	  only thing that differs is what each can see, and that difference is a declared input here.
16	  For the perception stage the manifest is the interface the other way round: the list of atoms
17	  its programs must deliver, with the error class each is allowed.
18	-/
19	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
20	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
21	import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Ontology.Ids
22	
23	namespace TrafficSpec
24	
25	inductive Capability
26	  | exact
27	  | estimate (errorClass : String)
28	  | absent
29	  | subject
30	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
31	
32	structure Manifest where
33	  source : String
34	  entries : List (String × Capability)     -- atom id in ATOMS.md form ↦ capability
35	  /-- The longest tracker break the source's re-identification links may bridge (seconds). -/
36	  reidGap : Q := Q.zero
37	  deriving Repr, Inhabited
38	
39	namespace Manifest
40	/-- An atom the manifest does not list is absent: silence is not a capability. -/
41	def capability (m : Manifest) (id : String) : Capability :=

106	        if seen.contains id then [] else

127	    the obligation reads is absent (the rule could never decide), or a binder's class can never be
128	    established, or a composed rule is itself unsupported. -/
129	def support (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (m : Manifest) : Support :=
130	  -- the clock is every source's: a window over time reads it, and no manifest declares it absent
131	  let absentOf (fs : List Formula) : List String × Nat :=
132	    let ids := (formulaAtomIds fs).filter (· != "kin.time")
133	    (ids.filter fun id => !m.observes id, ids.length)
134	  let (oblAbsent, oblTotal) := absentOf [r.obligation]
135	  let clsDead := r.binders.any fun b =>
136	    let (a, n) := absentOf [b.cls]
137	    n > 0 && a.length == n
138	  let composedDead := (r.composes.filterMap fun id => rules.find? (·.id == id)).any fun r' =>
139	    let (a, n) := absentOf [r'.obligation]
140	    n > 0 && a.length == n
141	  let allAbsent := (Rule.atomIds rules r).filter fun id => !m.observes id
142	  if allAbsent.isEmpty then .supported
143	  else if clsDead || composedDead || (oblTotal > 0 && oblAbsent.length == oblTotal) then .unsupported allAbsent
144	  else .partially allAbsent

def vZone : Arg := .var "z"

/-- s3, s10, s12, s13, s14, s17: the subject at rest (drv.motion.complete_halt). -/
def halt : Formula := .derived "drv_motion_complete_halt" [vSubject] [pHaltSpeedTolerance]

/-- s2, s7: the subject occupies the zone z. -/
def inZone : Formula := .atom "rel_occupies" [vSubject, vZone] []

def haltInZoneFor : Term := .sinceRise (.and halt inZone)

def clsSubject : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"] []

/-- (2) s9, s10: a tour bus, shuttle bus or limo, in a zone of kind tour_bus_loading, at rest in it
    for at most thirty minutes. -/
def excTourBus : Formula :=
  .and (.or (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-LVMC-11-02-150::tour_bus"] [])
         (.or (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-LVMC-11-02-150::shuttle_bus"] [])
              (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-LVMC-11-02-090::limo"] [])))
    (.and (.atom "st_curb_zone_kind" [vZone, .lit "tour_bus_loading"] [])
      (.and halt (.cmp haltInZoneFor .le thirtyMinutes)))

/-- (3) s11, s12: an RTC bus, in a zone of kind bus_stop, at rest in it for at most thirty minutes. -/
def excRtcBus : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "ru_aggregate" [vSubject, .lit "DEF-LVMC-11-02-120::rtc_bus"] [])
    (.and (.atom "st_curb_zone_kind" [vZone, .lit "bus_stop"] [])
      (.and halt (.cmp haltInZoneFor .le thirtyMinutes)))

  .or (.and (.atom "ru_official_vehicle" [vSubject] [])
            (.atom "ru_official_vehicle_kind" [vSubject, .lit "armored_car"] []))
      (.atom "ru_emergency_vehicle" [vSubject] [])

/-- (5) s16, s17, s18: a mail drop box within reach of the subject's body, the subject at rest in z

                (.cmp (.measure "st_region_geometry_distance" [vSubject, .var "o"]) .le pMailDropBoxReach)))
    (.and halt (.cmp haltInZoneFor .le pMailDepositMaxHalt))

/-
  Witnesses for LVMC_11_52_030_A.

  Geometry (every figure is the witness's own): one eastbound lane 10, x 0…100 m, y 0…4 m; a curb
  zone 20 along its north edge, x 20…60 m, y 3…4 m, of the kind and colour each scene names. A car
  (half-extents 2.5 m × 1 m) or a bus (6 m × 1.25 m) runs along y = 3 m, so its body overlaps the
  lane and, between x 20 and 60, the zone. A vehicle "pulls in": at the first instant it moves at
  3 m/s at x = 10 m, its body clear of the zone; from the second instant it is at rest at x = 40 m,
  inside the zone. Speeds at rest are zero (tolerance 0.1 m/s). A mail drop box (obstruction 30) is
  a 1 m square either 0.5 m north of the halted car's body (within the 3 m reach) or 27.5 m away.
  Devices govern lane 10 (a travel region the subject occupies).
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.LVMC_11.LVMC_11_52_030_A
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.LVMC_11_52_030_A

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n

-- Binders ↦ tracks: subject ↦ 1

def laneL : Structure := Build.lane 10 [(m 0, m 0), (m 100, m 0), (m 100, m 4), (m 0, m 4)] Build.east

def zone (kind : CurbZoneKind) (colour : CurbColour) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 20 .curbZone (m 20) (m 3) (m 60) (m 4) with curbKind := some kind, curbColour := some colour }

/-- A mail drop box: a 1 m square north of the curb, its west edge at `x0`. -/
def dropBox (x0 : Int) : Structure :=
  { Build.rect 30 .obstruction (m x0) (cm 450) (m (x0 + 1)) (cm 550) with obstructionKind := some .mailDropBox }

def carDims : Q × Q × Q := (cm 250, cm 100, cm 75)
def busDims : Q × Q × Q := (m 6, cm 125, m 2)

/-- A road user that approaches clear of the zone at instant 0 and is at rest in it afterwards. -/
def pullIn (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (dims : Q × Q × Q) (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  if k == 0 then Build.user track classes (m 10, m 3) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 3) dims
  else Build.user track classes (m 40, m 3) Build.east Q.zero dims

/-- As `pullIn`, then at instant `leaveAt` and after it drives on, clear of the zone at x = 70 m. -/
def pullInAndLeave (track : TrackId) (classes : List RoadUserClass) (dims : Q × Q × Q) (leaveAt k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  if k ≥ leaveAt then Build.user track classes (m 70, m 3) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 3) dims
  else pullIn track classes dims k

/-- `forbid` (violated): A curb zone z (st.curb_zone, colour red, kind no_stopping) along a street. The subject, a passenger car (ru.motor_vehicle), pulls into z and stands there at rest for several minutes; no other road user is in the scene and no device governs its region. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 5 0 (Units.seconds 60) fun k t =>
    Build.scene t (some 1)
      [ pullIn 1 [.motorVehicle] carDims k ]
      [ laneL, zone .noStopping .red ]
      [ ]

/-- `permit` (compliant): The same car drives along z at a steady speed, its footprint overlapping z, and leaves it without halting. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 7 0 (Units.seconds 1) fun k t =>
    Build.scene t (some 1)
      [ Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] (m (10 + 10 * (k : Int)), m 3) Build.east (Units.metresPerSecond 10) carDims ]
      [ laneL, zone .noStopping .red ]
      [ ]

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The same car halts for several minutes in a curb zone whose colour is none. -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 5 0 (Units.seconds 60) fun k t =>
    Build.scene t (some 1)
      [ pullIn 1 [.motorVehicle] carDims k ]
      [ laneL, zone .noStopping .none ]
      [ ]

/-- `blind` (unknown): As in forbid, but the source supplies no speed for the subject (kin.speed absent): whether it halts is unknown. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := forbidTrace

/-- `branch_1` (violated): A tour bus (ru.tour_bus_or_limousine) halts for ten minutes in a red zone of kind no_stopping, no other road user present and no device governing its region: the zone is not of kind tour_bus_loading, so exception (2) does not hold whatever the bus's aggregate membership, and the halt is a prohibited stop. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace :=

      [ pullIn 1 [.tourBusOrLimousine] busDims k ]
      [ laneL, zone .noStopping .red ]
      [ ]

def branch_2Trace : Trace :=

      [ laneL, zone .tourBusLoading .red ]
      [ ]

def branch_3Trace : Trace :=

      [ laneL, zone .noStopping .red ]

    for fifteen minutes: exception (4). -/

    Build.scene t (some 1)
      [ { pullIn 1 [.emergencyVehicle] carDims k with emergencyKind := some .ambulance } ]

    expeditious-deposit bound exception (5) no longer holds. -/

      [ ]

/-- `branch_9` (compliant): a car halts in the red zone at a police officer's stop direction governing
    its lane. -/
def branch_9Trace : Trace :=
  Build.trace 4 0 (Units.seconds 60) fun k t =>

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Adequacy
  Mutation adequacy of a rule's witnesses: every leaf of the applicability and the obligation
  must do some work in some witness. A leaf is replaced by `tt` and by `ff` in turn; if neither
  replacement changes any scenario's episode verdict, the leaf is unexercised — the witnesses do
  not show that it matters, and a rule could carry an irrelevant atom without anyone noticing.
  Only the witnesses that expect a decided verdict count: a witness that expects unknown under a
  mask is decided by blanking any leaf that reads the masked atom, so it exercises nothing.

  A concept call is one leaf: the rule's witnesses must show the concept matters, and the
  concept's own witnesses exercise its body.

  Leaves of one atom that differ only in a literal argument (the values of one enumeration, each
  tested in its own disjunct) are one leaf in meaning: the family is unexercised only when none of
  its members moves a witness, and it is reported once.

  Only the gate reads this file; rules never import it.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Adequacy

/-- The verdict tag one scenario produces for a rule: the episode verdict's tag, or the whole error. -/
def tagOf (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (cs : List Concept) (sc : Scenario) : String :=
  match sc.run ((rules.filter (·.id != r.id)) ++ [r]) cs with
  | .ok v => v.tag
  | .error e => s!"error:{e}"

/-- The verdict tags a scenario list produces for a rule. -/
def profile (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (scs : List Scenario) (cs : List Concept := []) : List String :=
  scs.map (tagOf rules r cs)

/-- Whether the scenarios' tags for `r` differ from `base`, their tags for the unchanged rule
    (`profile rules r scs cs != base`), decided at the first scenario whose tag differs. -/
def moves (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (cs : List Concept) : List Scenario → List String → Bool
  | sc :: scs, b :: bs => if tagOf rules r cs sc != b then true else moves rules r cs scs bs
  | [], [] => false
  | _, _ => true

/-- A leaf's family: its description with every literal argument blanked, so the leaves that
    test the values of one enumeration on the same atom and variables share a family. -/
def family (leaf : String) : String :=
  let marker := "Arg.lit \""
  match leaf.splitOn marker with
  | [] => leaf
  | first :: rest =>
    rest.foldl (fun acc piece =>
      let after := (piece.splitOn "\"").drop 1      -- drop the literal's text, keep what follows its closing quote
      acc ++ marker ++ "_\"" ++ "\"".intercalate after) first

/-- One part's report, given its leaves (`names`, in order) and which of them move a witness: a
    family of literal variants counts once and only when no member moves, reported at its first
    leaf with the count of its members. A family's members are asked in order, and the first that
    moves settles it. -/
def report (label : String) (names : List String) (moved : Nat → Bool) : List String :=
  let fams := names.map family
  let firsts := (List.range names.length).filter fun k => !((fams.take k).contains (fams[k]?.getD ""))
  firsts.filterMap fun k =>
    let fam := fams[k]?.getD ""
    let members := (List.range names.length).filter fun j => fams[j]?.getD "" == fam
    if members.any moved then none
    else
      let note := if members.length > 1 then s!" (one of {members.length} literal variants of this atom; none exercised)" else ""
      some s!"{label} leaf {k}: {names[k]?.getD ""}{note}"

/-- Leaves of the applicability and the obligation (binder classes are exercised by the
    grounding itself) that neither `tt` nor `ff` replacement moves any witness on, reported by
    `report`. -/
def unexercised (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (scs : List Scenario) (cs : List Concept := []) : List String :=
  let decided := scs.filter fun sc => sc.expected.tag != "unknown"
  let base := profile rules r decided cs
  let check (label : String) (get : Rule → Formula) (put : Rule → Formula → Rule) : List String :=
    let φ := get r
    report label (Formula.leaves φ) fun k => [Formula.tt, Formula.ff].any fun rep =>
      moves rules (put r (Formula.replaceLeaf k rep φ)) cs decided base
  check "applicability" (·.applicability) (fun r φ => { r with applicability := φ }) ++
  check "obligation" (·.obligation) (fun r φ => { r with obligation := φ })

end Adequacy
end TrafficSpec

8	  the per-grounding timeline of verdicts.
9	
10	  A track is a source's identity, not an object's. When a tracker breaks and the adapter claims a
11	  continuation (`Scene.links`, old ↦ new), the trace is rewritten once to canonical identities
12	  when the break is shorter than the manifest's re-identification gap; the instants inside the gap
13	  are unknown (identityGap), never a fresh party. A binder whose track is not present at an
14	  instant outside any gap leaves the rule not engaged there: the other party has left the scene.
15	
16	  Groundings are tuples of distinct candidates that are co-present at some instant; each
17	  grounding evaluates the rule once over the whole trace, and formulas that depend on a subset of
18	  the binders are shared across the groundings that agree on that subset.
19	
20	  Rules never import this file: a rule that could see the census of tracks could special-case it.
21	-/
22	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
23	import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Admission
24	
25	namespace TrafficSpec
26	namespace Grounding
27	open Semantics
28	
29	/-- An assignment of canonical tracks to binder names, and of regions to the variables a
30	    concept's instance takes as region formals (a rule's groundings bind none). -/
31	structure Grounding where
32	  assign : List (String × TrackId)
33	  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []
34	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
35	
36	def Grounding.render (g : Grounding) : String :=
37	  String.intercalate "," (g.assign.map fun (n, t) => s!"{n}={t}")
38	def Grounding.binding (g : Grounding) : Binding :=
39	  ⟨g.assign.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Val.track t)) ++ g.regions.map fun (n, r) => (n, Val.region r)⟩
40	
41	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
42	-- Identity: canonical tracks through accepted links, applied to the trace once
43	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
44	/-- The scene with every track id replaced by its canonical identity. -/
45	def canonicalScene (cm : List (TrackId × TrackId)) (s : Scene) : Scene :=
46	  let c := canon cm
47	  { s with
48	    subject := s.subject.map c
49	    users := s.users.map fun u => { u with track := c u.track }
50	    occupancyObserved := s.occupancyObserved.map c
51	    occupies := s.occupies.map fun (t, r) => (c t, r)
52	    relations := s.relations.map fun m => { m with a := c m.a, b := c m.b }
53	    intents := s.intents.map fun d => { d with vehicle := c d.vehicle } }
54	
55	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
56	-- Setup: the canonical, indexed trace and the rule set
57	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
58	structure Setup where
59	  rules : List Rule
60	  d : Primitives.Ctx
61	  gap : Q
62	  cm : List (TrackId × TrackId) := []
63	
64	def Setup.mk' (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Setup :=
65	  let arr := τ.toArray
66	  let cm := canonMap arr gap
67	  { rules := rules, d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' (τ.map (canonicalScene cm)) ρ, gap := gap, cm := cm }
68	
69	/-- The setup of a trace every evaluation reaches: built only when `Admission.defects` finds no
70	    defect in the trace as written, else the defects. -/
71	def Setup.admit (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Except (List String) Setup :=
72	  match Admission.defects τ gap with
73	  | [] => .ok (Setup.mk' rules τ ρ gap)
74	  | ds => .error ds
75	
76	def Setup.n (S : Setup) : Nat := S.d.n
77	def Setup.scenes (S : Setup) : Array Scene := S.d.scenes
78	def Setup.ctx (S : Setup) (β : Binding) : SemCtx := Rule.context S.rules S.d β
79	def Setup.tracks (S : Setup) : List TrackId := (S.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
80	/-- First and last instant at which a canonical identity is present. -/
81	def Setup.span (S : Setup) (t : TrackId) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
82	  match firstSeen S.scenes t, lastSeen S.scenes t with
83	  | some a, some b => some (a, b)
84	  | _, _ => none
85	
86	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
87	-- Enumeration
88	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
89	/-- Tracks that satisfy a binder's class at some instant (evaluated once per track). -/
90	def candidates (S : Setup) (b : Binder) : List TrackId :=
91	  S.tracks.filter fun t =>
92	    (Rule.evalRuleFormula (S.ctx ⟨[(b.name, .track t)]⟩) b.cls).any fun r => r.v == .t
93	
94	def spansOverlap (S : Setup) (a b : TrackId) : Bool :=
95	  match S.span a, S.span b with
96	  | some (a0, a1), some (b0, b1) => a0 ≤ b1 && b0 ≤ a1
97	  | _, _ => false
98	
99	/-- All assignments of distinct, pairwise co-present candidates to the binders, subject first.
100	    Each binder's candidates are computed once. -/
101	def groundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : List Grounding :=
102	  let cands := r.binders.map fun b => (b.name, candidates S b)
103	  let rec go (bs : List (String × List TrackId)) (used : List TrackId) : List (List (String × TrackId)) :=
104	    match bs with
105	    | [] => [[]]
106	    | (name, cs) :: rest =>
107	      cs.filter (fun c => !used.contains c && used.all (spansOverlap S c)) |>.flatMap fun c =>
108	        (go rest (c :: used)).map fun tail => (name, c) :: tail
109	  (go cands []).map fun a => { assign := a }
110	
111	/-- Predicted grounding count without enumerating: the product of candidate counts (an upper
112	    bound when candidates overlap). -/
113	def predictedGroundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : Nat :=
114	  r.binders.foldl (fun acc b => acc * (candidates S b).length) 1

/-

  atoms the split omits are removed. Do not edit; regenerate.
